title: dashscope-image-gen/prompt-generator output
description: Audit P1-8: contract for the JSON envelope the prompt-generator agent must emit. The framework's event-chain wakes the sibling image-generator runtime when `events[0].topic === 'image.generate.requested'` and `events[0].data.prompt` is non-empty. When the LLM drops the events array (or drops `data.prompt`), the image-generator never fires and the gallery silently shows nothing — this schema documents the required shape so plugin authors can wire structured-output enforcement once the executor surfaces `output.schema` to provider request bodies.

prompt.description: Final image prompt — the same string that appears in events[0].data.prompt.

promptMode.description: Output style. text=natural-language prompt; image-json=structured JSON-as-string.

composition.description: Optional. Picture composition mode. single-scene=one moment as a single frame; comic-strip=one comic page rendered as a single image with multiple sequential panels along a timeline. Forwarded to events[0].data.composition for tracing only — DashScope itself does not branch on this field.

events.description: Must contain exactly one event with topic 'image.generate.requested' and a non-empty data.prompt — that wakes the image-generator follower.

composition.description: Optional. Mirrors the top-level composition; passes through to image-generator.handler for trace logging.
